summary: Customer manufactures tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients. Laboratory checks tell whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press. They want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes, with a first pilot comparing reasonable measurement options before committing to production equipment.
